items.title: George Avakian interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 21, 1998
items.q: During his career he has produced albums with many of the greatest artists in jazz, including Miles Davis, Dave Brubeck and Louis Armstrong.

ctx.x: Producer/historian George Avakian has played a major role in the development of jazz and popular music in America. He was born in Armenia in 1919 and immigrated with his family to the U.S. While a student at Yale, he produced the pioneering documentary jazz album “Chicago Jazz” while also entering the field of jazz journalism. During his career he has produced albums with many of the greatest artists in jazz, including Miles Davis, Dave Brubeck and Louis Armstrong. His writing on music has appeared in Down Beat,…
George was interviewed in Clinton, New York on April 21, 1998, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
